description: The file is a Java Spring MVC Controller class named 'ProfesorController' responsible for managing CRUD operations and view routing related to 'Profesor' entities within a web application.

classes.name: ProfesorController
classes.description: A Spring MVC Controller class handling HTTP requests related to 'Profesor' entities, including adding, editing, deleting, listing, and viewing details of professors.

methods.name: addProfesor
methods.description: Handles GET requests to display a form for adding a new professor; adds a new DTO object to the model.

methods.name: saveProfesor
methods.description: Handles POST requests to save a new 'Profesor' using the provided DTO; redirects to the list view.

methods.name: getProfesorForUpdate
methods.description: Handles GET requests to retrieve and display an existing professor's data for editing.

methods.name: updateProfesor
methods.description: Handles POST requests to update an existing professor's data with provided form data.

methods.name: patchProfesor
methods.description: Handles POST requests to partially update a 'Profesor' entity's details.

methods.name: getProfesoresList
methods.description: Handles GET requests to list all professors.

methods.name: deleteProfesor
methods.description: Handles GET requests to delete a specified professor.

methods.name: getProfesorDetail
methods.description: Handles GET requests to display detailed information about a specific professor, including associated courses.
